ranked_facts.concept_key: Immunohistochemical analysis for S100 protein and SOX10
ranked_facts.why: The strong positivity for S100 protein and SOX10 is more characteristic of gastrointestinal clear cell sarcoma than of gastrointestinal stromal tumor, metastatic neoplasm, or primary melanoma.

ranked_facts.concept_key: Microscopic examination of transmural, infiltrative proliferation
ranked_facts.why: The transmural, infiltrative proliferation of uniform epithelioid and spindle cells is more characteristic of gastrointestinal stromal tumor than of gastrointestinal clear cell sarcoma, metastatic neoplasm, or primary melanoma.
